description: The decal catalog: every sticker, graphic, shape and retro distributor mark the designer offers (a title's own posters / logos / stills come from get_content instead), grouped by category, each with its id (what decals[].id takes), natural pixel size and preview URLs — plus the Classic Logo ids style.productionLogos takes. Call it before placing decals; ids are exact strings, never guessed. Pass a category id to get one category, or a query to search names.

query.description: Case-insensitive match on decal id / name

name: list_decals
